encode_bbox_deltas: encode anchor bboxes into YOLO-style center and size deltas relative to ground truth boxes
decode_pred_bboxes: decode predicted YOLO bbox deltas back into absolute x1y1x2y2 coordinates using anchor boxes
create_yolo_coder: create a YOLOBBoxCoder instance with a configurable epsilon for clamping center coordinates
review_encode_method: review the encode method that transforms bboxes into cx, cy, dw, dh YOLO format
review_decode_method: review the decode method that reconstructs decoded bboxes from predicted deltas and anchors
